text: Thousands of government schemes exist to help people across India. Most people never hear about the ones meant for them.
Meet YojanaSahay. One free app that finds them for you.
Search over a thousand Central and State schemes, by category, by state, or by who they're for.
Not sure what you qualify for? Answer a few quick questions, and see every scheme that matches you, in seconds.
Open any scheme to see its benefits, who can apply, and exactly how to apply.
Still unsure? Ask the AI assistant, in Hindi or English, and get clear next steps made for you.
Use it in Hindi or English, on the web, as an Android app, or right inside Telegram.
YojanaSahay is free and independent, built by Sahnawaz Ahmed Laskar, so no one misses what is rightfully theirs.
Find your schemes today, at yojanasahay.vercel.app
